Custom 6-1/2" x 19-5/8" Stainless Steel Pull Plate with #10 Pull

This custom size pull plate made of .050" thick high quality solid stainless steel for longevity. Packaged with matching stainless steel mounting screws for easy installation. Satin Stainless Steel finish.

Specifications for the DJO-6.5x19-5/8-630 Pull Plate:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Plate Length: 19-5/8"
  • Plate Width: 6-1/2"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged With Matching Stainless Steel Mounting Screws

Sold Individually
